title: Signature Tower of the Four Winds
body:
Signature Tower of the Four Winds is an original Signature design for a 300-metre tower whose crown is four open wind courts, one facing each compass point, where visitors can stand in the wind that shapes the building. Its lower floors hold a public market, and its middle floors hold a vertical library.

This is an original Signature design, labelled Signature, and it is not presented as an established fact or as an existing product. It is a complete design record: what the design is, how it works, and what makes it distinct, with a working demo program that models one measurable aspect of it.

floors = 60
print(f"Average floor height: {height} m / {floors} floors = {height / floors:.2f} m")
demo_output: Average floor height: 300 m / 60 floors = 5.00 m
